question: network-supply-connection-hv-metering
unit: NZD lump sum per supply point (300 kVA connected capacity), GST exclusive

band.unit: NZD lump sum per supply point (300 kVA connected capacity), GST exclusive
band.basis: Working estimate (not a certified price) for one complete, live and registered 300 kVA HV supply point, Vector Auckland urban network, priced in Auckland rates and GST exclusive. Sum of the nine components above: low $94,471, high $357,938. Amortised over 300 kVA: low $315/kVA, high $1,193/kVA, centre $500/kVA. Main cost driver is Vector's capital contribution for the network-owned 300 kVA dedicated substation and HV protection/switchgear, which Vector prices per job; it is proxied on Vector's published posted capacity rates ($176.67/kVA distribution substation, $715.89/kVA HV feeder, 1 Apr 2026). Because the scenario states no network reinforcement, the centre ($150,000) sits below the arithmetic midpoint (~$226,000); the band would narrow materially once Vector issues its Customer Works Agreement price. Allowances (HV terminations, metering, coordination) carry well under one third of the total. Confidence low.

band.unit: sum (one complete 300 kVA HV-supplied supply point, live and registered)
band.basis: Auckland, NZD, GST exclusive. Sum of eight distinct components (no overlap): Vector design fee (web), Vector capital contribution incl. transformer/HV switchgear (web capacity-rate proxy), 30 m HV cable (QV proxy) + 11kV terminations (allowance), 30 m within-site HV trench (allowance), 25 m LV service (QV), Category 4 CT metering (allowance), coordination/commissioning/certification (allowance). Low $101,251 = $337.50/kVA; high $195,502 = $651.67/kVA; centre $148,377 = $494.59/kVA over the 300 kVA nominal capacity. Allowances carry ~17-23% of the total, under one third. Dominant uncertainty is Vector's per-job connection fee for the transformer and HV switchgear, which is proxied (not published) by the distribution-substation capacity rate; that single item is ~52-54% of the band, so confidence is low and the band should be replaced by Vector's Customer Works Agreement figure as soon as it is issued.

Working estimate band for one complete 300 kVA HV-supplied supply point, GST-exclusive, Auckland. Sum of: Vector fees (application/assessment allowance + $3,000 design fee) + Vector capital contribution (posted network-capacity rate $176.67/kVA x 300 kVA = $53,001, plus a weak equipment-only proxy for the sole-use transformer/HV switchgear connection fee) + HV cable allowance + QV LV service main + metering allowance + coordination allowance. Amortised: $366-$457 per kVA over the 300 kVA nominal capacity. Allowances are 14-26% of the total, so the band does not rest on judgement alone, but the two largest Vector lines are indicative/per-job and the transformer line is an offshore proxy - hence LOW confidence. NOT a certified price; Vector's per-job connection fee and development contribution must be substituted when the Customer Works Agreement issues.
